sources.name: Unicode Standard Annex #9: Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm
W3C Internationalization: Inline markup and bidirectional text in HTML

provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

statement.ar: ضع كل مقطع معاكس للاتجاه داخل عزل اتجاهي (bdi أو dir على عنصر مضمّن أو unicode-bidi: isolate). لا تستخدم التضمين (RLE/LRE أو unicode-bidi: embed) ولا علامات الاتجاه المنفردة (LRM/RLM) لإصلاح الترتيب.
statement.en: Wrap every opposite-direction run in a directional isolate (bdi, dir on an inline element, or unicode-bidi: isolate). Do not use embeddings (RLE/LRE, unicode-bidi: embed) or loose direction marks (LRM/RLM) to repair ordering.

rationale.ar: التضمين يغيّر مستوى المقطع لكنه يبقى مرئيًا لما حوله: الأرقام وعلامات الترقيم على حدوده تتفاعل مع النص المجاور. العزل يجعل المقطع كله يتصرف كحرف محايد واحد، فلا يؤثر في جيرانه ولا يتأثر بهم.
rationale.en: An embedding changes the level of a run but the run stays visible to its surroundings: digits and punctuation at its edges still interact with neighbouring text. An isolate makes the whole run behave like one neutral character, so it neither affects nor is affected by its neighbours.

checks: No stylesheet declares unicode-bidi: embed or bidi-override except on an element documented as an override (e.g. a reversed-text demo).
No template or message string contains U+202A, U+202B, U+202D or U+202E.
For every case of mixed-direction with islands, rendering the islands as isolates yields expected.isolated.visualOrder.
An element that isolates has computed unicode-bidi isolate (bdi, or any element with a dir attribute).
